name.text: Approximating Area using Riemann Sums_Definite integral

questiontext.text:
Use Riemann Sum to approximate area under the curve of \(\displaystyle f(x) = {@func@}\) over the interval \([{@left_limit@}, {@right_limit@}]\) with \(n = {@rect_num@}\) rectangles.

The function has been plotted as shown below:

[[jsxgraph]] /*Values for bounding box.*/ var x_min = {#x_min#}; var x_max = {#x_max#}; var y_min = {#y_min#}; var y_max = {#y_max#}; var rect_width = {#rect_width#}; var rect_num = {#rect_num#}; var left_limit = {#left_limit#}; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [x_min, y_max, x_max, y_min], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); var f = board.jc.snippet('{#func#}', true, 'x', true); var sketch = board.create('functiongraph', [f, x_min, x_max]); /* Add labels*/ var label1 = board.create('text', [x_min + 2, y_max - 2, '\\(f(x) = {#func#}\\)'], { fixed: true, anchorX: 'left', fontSize: 15, useMathJax: true, parse: false }); [[/jsxgraph]]

Compute the approximate area under the curve using the left endpoint.
Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

\(\displaystyle A_{L} = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]


Compute the area under the curve using the right endpoint.
Give your answer to 2 decimal places.

\(\displaystyle A_{R} = \) [[input:ans2]] [[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]]


Evaluate the definite integral, giving your answer to 2 decimal places.
\(\displaystyle \int_2^{10} \left( {@func@}\right) \mathrm{d}x = \) [[input:ans3]] [[validation:ans3]][[feedback:prt3]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

For the interval \([a,b] = [{@left_limit@}, {@right_limit@}]\) and \( n={@rect_num@}\), the first step is to find the partition width \(\displaystyle \Delta x = \frac{b-a}{n} = \frac{{@right_limit@}-{@left_limit@}}{@rect_num@} = {@rect_width@}\)


Let \(x_i\) be the right endpoint of the \(i\)th rectangle and \(x_{i-1}\) be the left endpoint.

Consider the sketch below with {@rect_num@} rectangular partitions of width {@rect_width@} each.

[[jsxgraph]] /*Values for bounding box.*/ var x_min = {#x_min#}; var x_max = {#x_max#}; var y_min = {#y_min#}; var y_max = {#y_max#}; var rect_width = {#rect_width#}; var rect_num = {#rect_num#}; var left_limit = {#left_limit#}; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [x_min, y_max, x_max, y_min], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); var f = board.jc.snippet('{#func#}', true, 'x', true); var sketch = board.create('functiongraph', [f, x_min, x_max]); /* Add labels*/ var label1 = board.create('text', [x_min + 2, y_max - 2, '\\(f(x)={#func#}\\)'], { fixed: true, anchorX: 'left', fontSize: 15, useMathJax: true, parse: false }); /*Create rectangles*/ var y_right_rect_vals = {#rect_top_y_coords_lowersum#}; var y_left_rect_vals = {#rect_top_y_coords_uppersum#}; var position = "right"; var y_rect_vals = []; if (position == "right") { y_rect_vals = y_right_rect_vals } else { y_rect_vals = y_left_rect_vals }; for (var i = 1; i <= rect_num; i++) { var rectangle = board.create('polygon', [ [left_limit + (i - 1) * rect_width, 0], [left_limit + (i - 0) * rect_width, 0], [left_limit + (i - 0) * rect_width, y_rect_vals[i-1]], [left_limit + (i - 1) * rect_width, y_rect_vals[i-1]] ], { fixed: true, highlight: false, color: '#A8FE9E', borders: { fixed: true, highlight: false }, vertices: { visible: false } }) }; [[/jsxgraph]]

To find the height of the rectangles, evaluate the function at the left endpoint of each rectangle.

For the left endpoint approximation \(\displaystyle A_L\), we compute the sum of the areas of rectangles touching the curve from the left side.

\(\begin{align*} A_L &= \sum_{i=0}^{@rect_num-1@} f(x_i)\Delta x \\ &= ({@sum_fxi_lower@})\Delta x \\ &= ({@sum_efxi_lower@})\cdot{@rect_width@} \\ &= {@ta1@} \hspace{10px} \text{(2dp)} \end{align*}\)

\(n\) is the number of rectangles (subintervals).

\(f(x_i)\) is the value of the function at the \(i^{th}\) partition point.

\(\displaystyle \Delta x \) is the width of each rectangle (partition width).


[[jsxgraph]] /*Values for bounding box.*/ var x_min = {#x_min#}; var x_max = {#x_max#}; var y_min = {#y_min#}; var y_max = {#y_max#}; var rect_width = {#rect_width#}; var rect_num = {#rect_num#}; var left_limit = {#left_limit#}; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [x_min, y_max, x_max, y_min], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); var f = board.jc.snippet('{#func#}', true, 'x', true); var sketch = board.create('functiongraph', [f, x_min, x_max]); /* Add labels*/ var label1 = board.create('text', [x_min + 2, y_max - 2, '\\(f(x)={#func#}\\)'], { fixed: true, anchorX: 'left', fontSize: 15, useMathJax: true, parse: false }); /*Create rectangles*/ var y_right_rect_vals = {#rect_top_y_coords_lowersum#}; var y_left_rect_vals = {#rect_top_y_coords_uppersum#}; var position = "left"; var y_rect_vals = []; if (position == "right") { y_rect_vals = y_right_rect_vals } else { y_rect_vals = y_left_rect_vals }; for (var i = 1; i <= rect_num; i++) { var rectangle = board.create('polygon', [ [left_limit + (i - 1) * rect_width, 0], [left_limit + (i - 0) * rect_width, 0], [left_limit + (i - 0) * rect_width, y_rect_vals[i-1]], [left_limit + (i - 1) * rect_width, y_rect_vals[i-1]] ], { fixed: true, highlight: false, color: '#A8FE9E', borders: { fixed: true, highlight: false }, vertices: { visible: false } }) }; [[/jsxgraph]]

For the Right endpoint approximation \(\displaystyle A_L\), we use the formula

\(\begin{align*} A_R &= \sum_{i=1}^{@rect_num@} f(x_i)\Delta x \\ &= ({@sum_fxi_upper@})\Delta x \\ &= ({@sum_efxi_upper@})\cdot{@rect_width@} \\ &= {@ta2@} \hspace{10px} \text{(2dp)} \\ \end{align*}\)

This time we take the sum of the areas of rectangles touching the curve at the right-hand side.


Finally, \(\displaystyle \int_{@left_limit@}^{{@right_limit@}} \left( {@func@}\right) \mathrm{d}x = {@ta3@} \hspace{10px} \text{(2dp)} \)
